findings.claim: Original 00406920 mode 0x0E installs 00406AB0. Original 00406AB0, though undefined as a function in v97 Ghidra, obtains the genuine registered class-1 vehicle runtime with 00467440 and tests runtime+0x398 at 00406B02. That pointer is null in both original-VFC-constructed GTSi and bus and the callback returns early; original constructor 00463068 explicitly initializes this field to zero.
findings.limitations: Original x86 executed in Ghidra on real constructed/registered vehicles; missing later runtime initialization is not claimed absent in full retail gameplay; class-dependent callbacks and game loop only partially initialized.

findings.claim: Original 00405B90 callback executed with a genuine original-VCF class-1 vehicle root registered via 004572B0, reached native transform helpers 00494E20/00494170/00494DA0 and updated persistent camera 004C2730 using original 00472990. Both GTSi and bus original-instruction runs completed with 2054 steps of this callback; a separate controlled-entry test returned after 18 instructions when the entry was unbound.
findings.limitations: 0049D400 sin/cos, 004BA090 FTOL and 004944D0 quaternion interpolation were substituted; Ghidra FPATAN unsupported. Resulting camera translation bits are demonstrably unreliable as physical coordinates; this is a control-flow/data-flow contract, not a usable scene camera.

findings.claim: Original PE 00406AB0 has a standalone entry prologue and is the indirect callback target selected by original 00406920. The v97 annotated Ghidra program does not define a function at 00406AB0. This is an annotation boundary gap, not evidence of missing retail code.
findings.limitations: Do not rename or define functions in the private baseline without a separately guarded annotation pass and verified function extent.

findings.claim: The original runtime source and ownership of a non-null vehicle runtime+0x398 camera dependency, authentic mode activation timing, stable x87 camera transforms and camera-to-frustum/raster numerical parity remain unresolved.
findings.limitations: Existing native registered vehicle scene setup lacks full retail player runtime and camera target initialization.
